Dear Friends,

We know it's hard to keep up with all the latest updates when it comes to the
US-Israeli war on Iran. We also know it is frustrating to have to try and
cover what's happening in the Middle East via the mainstream media, with its
biased headlines, softball interviews, and dehumanizing coverage of Arabs and
Iranians. So below, to help out, we've listed some of _**our**_ latest
articles on the recent developments; **Mehdi 's **interviews with actual
experts offering much-needed context; and some of **Zeteo 's** most widely-
shared pieces since the start of this illegal conflict one week ago.

For those of you who are free subscribers**** to **Zeteo** and who have been
appreciating our coverage, do consider upgrading to a _**paid**_ subscription
today,__ if you can. There is also the option of **donating** to us
